QuestInfo.name: Using Scrolls
QuestInfo.0: Arby wants to teach you how to use #bscrolls#k on your equipment.
QuestInfo.1: Arby taught you how to use #bscrolls#k on your equipment.
QuestInfo.2: Arby taught you how to use #bscrolls#k on your equipment.

0.0: I know you want to be strong, like a real champ, right?
0.1: One way to do that is to collect and use all sorts of #bequipment scrolls#k. These'll let you enhance your gear.
0.2: To make it work, you need both a #bscroll#k and a piece of #bequipment#k to use it on.\r\n#i2046093# + #i1252000#
0.3: Make sure that the #bscroll can be used#k on that particular piece of equipment.\r\nOtherwise, it just won't work!
0.4: Then, just #bdrag the scroll onto the equipment#k!\r\nIf you have too many scrolls to keep track of, you can also click the #bhammer icon#k at the bottom of your Inventory. This shows your scrolls in a more organized layout.

yes.0: Take this #b#t2046093;##k and use it to enhance your gear and grow strong!
